text: Underway here in match ten!
Buffon.exe signals an immediate push into midfield, looking to build on Dynamo Datacenter's four-goal win against AFC Fable.
Buffon.exe strides up the left flank, taking Dynamo deep into the final third.
The corner push-panel spits the magenta ball back into open territory.
Robodinho breaks clear from midfield, clean through on goal here!
Robodinho charges centrally, right into the danger area!
Just inches wide from close range—a tremendous early let-off for Dynamo.
Buffon.exe urgently calls for an immediate defensive clearance.
Synthetic Athletic have Dynamo pinned right back against the goal line, heaping on early pressure.
GOAL! Robodinho turns it home from point-blank range! Synthetic Athletic take a one-nil lead!
Griezmatronn is flattened in the centre circle!
Mbapp-E advances rapidly through the middle and cuts across into the left channel.
The corner panel clangs into life, firing the ball back into the defensive third.
Buffon.exe calls to help clear the danger.
Mbapp-E takes an awkward tumble wide.
Corner ram ejects it promptly.
Robodinho is wiped out by Buffon.exe.
Robodinho returns the favour immediately, sending Buffon.exe crashing down in midfield.
Robodinho springs clear again, nothing in the way!
A steady stride forward through the centre, driving Synthetic Athletic onto the attack.
A strike flashing just past the right upright! Robodinho comes close to a second.
A momentary pause as balance systems stabilise. Synthetic Athletic, keen to rebound after losing to Real Machina, look sharp in attack.
Mbapp-E signals the ball is stuck against the wall and works to push it free.
Robodinho powers to the line!
GOAL! Robodinho doubles the advantage! A clinical finish right on the doorstep makes it two-nil to Synthetic Athletic!
Griezmatronn steps in with a heavy challenge on the left touchline, sending Mbapp-E down.
Teammates collide and Robodinho falls!
Buffon.exe communicates an effort to work the ball loose in midfield.
Mbapp-E levels Griezmatronn with a crunching tackle!
Buffon.exe surges straight to goal!
Dynamo Datacenter mount serious late pressure in this first half, penning Synthetic Athletic back.
Buffon.exe is clean through in the right channel with the goal gaping!
That brings the opening half to a close. Synthetic Athletic lead two-nil thanks to Robodinho.
Another mix-up in red as Griezmatronn and Robodinho collide, leaving Robodinho down.
Robodinho struggles for balance and topples over in midfield, working to get upright.
Mbapp-E drives directly inside!
GOAL! Mbapp-E scores! Dynamo Datacenter pull one back to make it 2-1!
Dynamo Datacenter have laid siege to the final third, refusing to let the defence clear.
Agonisingly close! Mbapp-E shaves the post from two metres out!
Robodinho signals that the ball is jammed against the perimeter boards and needs freeing.
Mbapp-E breaks clear down the right touchline!
Mbapp-E carries the ball at speed along the flank, driving Dynamo forward with real intent.
A fierce strike skims just wide of the target, Synthetic Athletic scrambling in defense.
GOAL! Buffon.exe equalises! Dynamo Datacenter have levelled the match at 2-2!
Mbapp-E signals an aggressive posture from the restart, looking to keep the tempo high.
The ball rebounds into the corner and the mechanical ram sends it bouncing back out.
Another powered panel triggers, keeping things frantic with little over two minutes remaining.
Griezmatronn signals the intent to work play along the wall as time ticks down.
Robodinho clean through on goal!
Catastrophe at the back as the two Dynamo teammates collide, leaving Buffon.exe grounded!
Buffon.exe goes down again!
GOAL! Robodinho scores! A hat-trick makes it 3-2 to Synthetic Athletic!
Synthetic Athletic capitalise on sustained pressure to reclaim the lead with under two minutes remaining.
Robodinho clatters into Mbapp-E!
Inches away from another! The ball skids just wide of the open net!
GOAL! Buffon.exe strikes from point-blank range! Dynamo Datacenter level it at 3-3 with seventy-eight seconds left!
GOAL! Mbapp-E turns it in! Dynamo Datacenter take a stunning 4-3 lead in the final minute!
Buffon.exe hits the deck with thirty seconds left, but Dynamo are holding on for victory.
Full time: Synthetic Athletic 3, Dynamo Datacenter 4. Up next, Manus FC meet Codex City at noon.
